# Code Review MCP Server

> MCP server that lets AI assistants review GitHub Pull Requests and GitLab Merge Requests.

code-review-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for automated code review. It connects to GitHub and GitLab (including self-hosted GitLab), fetches PR/MR diffs, and exposes MCP tools for inline comments, batch comments, and custom project review rules. Works with Cursor, Claude Desktop, and any MCP-compatible client via stdio, SSE, or WebSocket.

## Documentation

- [README (English)](https://github.com/OldJii/code-review-mcp/blob/main/README.md): Full setup and configuration
- [README (中文)](https://github.com/OldJii/code-review-mcp/blob/main/README_CN.md): Chinese documentation
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/code-review-mcp/): `pip install code-review-mcp` or `uvx code-review-mcp`

## MCP tools

- `get_review_rules` — builtin + custom project rules
- `get_pr_info` — PR/MR metadata
- `get_pr_changes` — diff with optional file-type filter
- `add_inline_comment`, `add_pr_comment`, `batch_add_comments` — post review feedback

## Quick start

```bash
uvx code-review-mcp
# or: pip install code-review-mcp && code-review-mcp
```

Set `GITHUB_TOKEN` and/or `GITLAB_TOKEN` (and `GITLAB_HOST` for self-hosted).

## Common questions

- **Cursor setup**: Add to `~/.cursor/mcp.json` with command `uvx` and args `["code-review-mcp"]`
- **Self-hosted GitLab**: Set `GITLAB_HOST=gitlab.yourcompany.com`
- **Custom rules**: `code-review-mcp init-rules` or `CODE_REVIEW_RULES_DIR`
- **Remote deploy**: `--transport sse` or `--transport websocket` on port 8000
